summary: Teresa Proaño co-wrote a Gaza cease-fire resolution with Vice Mayor Daus-Magbual calling for a bilateral ceasefire, hostage release, and condemnation of killings in Gaza. The Daly City Council passed the resolution on June 4, 2024, as confirmed by the Mercury News, and CAIR-SFBA's tracker records her support, noting it is not a verified roll-call transcript. As a sitting councilmember, her co-authorship of this measure is a direct legislative action calling for an end to the fighting in Gaza.
